nom: SUNATORIA Original Black Peel Off Face Mask

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with large pores and a long history of failed clay and peel masks, report the mask controls shine and works well on blackheads with regular, even twice-weekly, use.
segments.dry: A couple of reviewers with dry skin used the mask sparingly on trouble spots or noted it added some moisture, since the charcoal formula itself is not inherently moisturizing.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation and good results, but others describe the mask drying out their skin and triggering a new breakout, and one reviewer's eczema-prone son reacted badly to it.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 60s report the mask shrank visibly enlarged pores and delivered results after other masks and treatments hadn't worked for them.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal, not oily, had no skin reaction to report but found the formula separated and wouldn't stay emulsified on her face.

concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the mask dried her skin out and was followed by a new breakout two days later, while another with dry skin describes it adding some moisture; the charcoal base is not moisturizing on its own and several reviewers apply cream afterward.
concerns.redness: Peeling the mask off commonly causes mild stinging and temporary redness, which several reviewers call expected and tolerable, but a handful describe more serious reactions: a rash-like burn, blistering, or raw, angry-red skin.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers report no skin damage, but a minority describe the mask removing skin, causing painful raw patches, or leaving scabs, including one case on a 12-year-old's skin; the company reportedly offered refunds or product swaps to some of the affected reviewers.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report visible blackhead and pore-clogging debris pulled out after peeling, with smaller-looking pores afterward, but several others say it left blackheads behind or produced no noticeable extraction despite following the instructions.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the mask absorbs excess oil and helps control shine over the T-zone, though it can leave already-dry skin feeling stripped since it is not a moisturizing formula.

I have sensitive skin but this product did some damage when it dried my skin out. I don’t suffer from acne & rarely break out but I developed a giant cyst zit on my chin two days after using this & my face continues to break out everywhere. Please beware. Pictures included to show dryness & huge breakouts received from this product.

This is my son's face in photos, and we were trying this product to remove blackheads to prevent my son from being tempted to pick at his skin. I didn't want him to end up with scars from picking, which he has not had the urge to thankfully. So we decided to try this product to remove blackheads on nose and chin. We did all the instructions stated, and waited for mask to dry. Once dry we removed slowly and my son squealed and I thought he was kidding around until I could see the raw spots. He rinsed with water afterwards and had burning sensation. Today we could already see scabs forming on his face. I'm praying it does not scar his face. He is only 12 with young skin and this looks like the product burned and skinned his nose. As you can see in photos it removed the skin, but still left the blackheads behind. extraits.titre: Head over Heels with this stuff!!!
extraits.texte: I was hesitant to order this mask. I am 68 and have been using a mask over the years from clay to peel off and then some mostly to address very small oil and blackheads that accumulate and don't really want to go away. I have oily skin and I have never had any success with them. Well this peel off mask has made me a believer! I did several things to make sure I had the best outcome - made sure my face was well washed - I sit at my vanity and did so for application so I would not get antsy. I made sure the mask was room temp, so I did not use the first day I received it in the mail. Seeing other comments about seperating on the face, I was not sure what to expect. The silicone spatula is soft and pliable and the mask was more liquid than I thought but that was a good thing. I only put a pea size amount on the edge of the spatula at a time and I only spread it so far, which helped keep it thick but I did notice on my cheek area it started to seperate and I believe it was because my skin was warm there - so I added more. I made sure to get my entire nose especially the crease area and I also did some below my chin and jawline. So I used more than I think I would have normally used, but the price is not that bad so.... I wanted to make sure the mask completely dried and went off into my office and did some work on the computer. extraits.titre: Beware if you have skin conditions
extraits.texte: The SUNATORIA Blackhead Remover Mask is a game-changer for my skincare routine! From the first use, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin, it felt smoother, looked clearer, and had a healthy glow. The mask is easy to apply and dries quickly without feeling overly tight, be careful when applying, if too much is applied it will take a long time to dry and make it difficult to use for its purpose which is removing blackheads. A thin layer made the experience beyond great. Removing it was satisfying, as it pulled out blackheads and impurities I didn’t even know were there. I also love that it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin, on the other hand my son has eczema and irritated his delicate skin a bit, so definitely not for him but me on the other hand am thrilled with the product. My pores look visibly smaller, and my T-zone stays oil-free longer. This is a must-have for anyone looking to deeply cleanse their skin!

I was skeptical I have to be honest. However, after applying this and leaving it on for 20 minutes, i was shocked and amazed at how beautiful my skin looks!! I'm soon to be 60 and it really cleaned out my pores and shrunk them in size after one use. I will definitely keep using it!! If you are on on the fence about purchasing it, get it! You will not regret it!
